# Worm Studio

> A UK SEO, GEO & AEO agency helping brands get found in Google and in AI search tools - done properly, never automated.

Based in Northampton, England. Services: technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), content writing, and Shopify development (official Shopify Partner).
